svg.title: Original island and province-character studies
svg.desc: Four newly drawn fictional geography studies inspired by Sicily, Cuba, Borneo and New Zealand. Coastlines and regions are original schematic illustrations, not traces, real administrative maps or valid game generator outputs. Captions are design-review annotations, not product labels.
